title: LJ78 to 1kzte
ai_summary: Owner (Ash Awbery) swapped a Hilux Surf-sourced 1KZ-TE into an LJ78, keeping the A343F automatic via the Surf's bellhousing/torque converter and running 4.88 diffs with 35-inch tires. Running the 1KZ-TE's electronic injection pump off the original 2L-TE ECU caused white smoke, unburnt fuel, and high idle; the fix was fitting a 4M40 manual injection pump. He planned to eventually 'manualise' the drivetrain and add a Spitronics ECU for transmission control.

complications.detail: 2L-TE ECU incompatible with 1KZ-TE electronic injection pump (10mm vs 12mm pump fueling mismatch), causing white smoke and high idle despite potentiometer tuning attempts
2L-TE engine mounts required modification, but Surf bellhousing/torque converter bolted to the A343F with no major issues
